description_en: Adds a cluster to a security group
description_zh: 调用AddSecurityGroup将集群加入到指定的安全组
kebab_example: aliyun ehpc add-security-group --cluster-id ehpc-hz-FYUr320000 --security-group-id sg-bp13n61xsydodfyg0000 --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --api-version 2018-04-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddSecurityGroup
